scenes.visual: photo of a night sky over Indian city rooftops on Diwali, one huge bright red firework burst and one green firework burst high in the sky, small oil lamps glowing along a terrace wall at the bottom of the frame, wide angle from the terrace, the bursts in the middle of the frame

narration.en: Firework colours are *not* dye. You're watching hot *metal* glow.
narration.hi: Patakhon ka rang dye *nahi* hai. Aap garam *metal* ko chamakte dekh rahe ho.

scenes.visual: 2D animation: a metal atom over a flame, the electron jumps to an outer ring, drops back and shoots out red light, then green

narration.en: The heat kicks tiny *electrons* up a level. When they drop back, they give off light of one exact *colour*.
narration.hi: Garmi se metal ke chhote *electrons* upar jump karte hain. Jab wo wapas girte hain, toh ek fixed *rang* ki light nikalti hai.

scenes.visual: photo of a school chemistry lab bench, a thin metal wire loop held in the flame of a small Bunsen burner, the flame burning bright crimson red, dark background, side view, sharp focus on the red flame

narration.en: Every metal has its *own* colour. Put strontium in a flame and it turns bright *red*.
narration.hi: Har metal ka apna *alag* rang hota hai. Strontium ko aag mein daalo, toh flame ekdum *laal* ho jaati hai.

scenes.visual: 2D animation: four firework bursts appear one by one with element tiles Sr red, Na yellow, Ba green, Cu blue

narration.en: Sodium gives *yellow*, barium gives *green*, and copper gives *blue*.
narration.hi: Sodium se *peela*, barium se *hara*, aur copper se *neela*.

scenes.visual: photo of a single deep blue firework burst against a dark night sky above a silhouetted city skyline, its outer sparks fading to white, wide shot, the burst in the middle of the frame

narration.en: Blue is the *hardest*. If the flame gets too hot, the copper compound breaks apart and the blue fades to *white*.
narration.hi: Neela sabse *mushkil* hai. Flame zyada garam ho jaaye, toh copper wala compound toot jaata hai aur neela rang *safed* pad jaata hai.

scenes.visual: photo of a young Indian couple in festive clothes on a rooftop terrace at night, seen from behind, looking up at red and green fireworks in the sky, rows of diyas on the terrace ledge, warm glow

narration.en: So this Diwali, when the sky turns red and green, you're watching *strontium* and *barium* light up.
narration.hi: Toh is Diwali jab aasmaan laal aur hara ho, samajh lena ye *strontium* aur *barium* chamak rahe hain.

scenes.visual: 2D animation: phone with a fireworks thumbnail, send to a friend, comment NEXT

narration.en: Send this to the friend who thinks it's paint. And comment NEXT for one more everyday thing we never question.
narration.hi: Us dost ko bhejo jo sochta hai ye paint hai. Aur aisi aur cheezein jaan-ni hain toh comment mein NEXT likho.
